activity_summary: After the afternoon you said, thick-voiced, that a small ailment had commanded the morning. You had told the house you were well. You did not treat the missed Titus as the thing that was lost.

entities.name: Titus Andronicus
entities.context: Mentioned in How small it is

facets.activity: Said a small ailment commanded the morning

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is a marvel how small an ailment is, and how much of a man's morning it will command.
